findings.text: Requirement 4 (the breakdown view, the owner's main ask) cannot be confirmed from the shots — every width shows "0 sessions shown" / "No sessions with an id yet.", and `layout.json`'s `errors` list a 404 for `spend-tree.json` at all four widths, so neither the existing `cost by role`/`cost by trigger` lists nor the new "Cache $ breakdown, all-time" list ever render. Land only after confirming `spend-tree.json` is actually served and the breakdown shows with real data — shots/127-0-0-1-63777-framework-ai-sessions/{400,1200,1920,3440}.png, layout.json `errors`.

Same gap on a session's own detail page: the new "Logged cost" input/cache-write/cache-read/output row (page.js ~1253) is gated on `costs.at(-1)?.usd_breakdown`, but with 0 sessions shown there is no session row to open — this half of the deliverable is also unverified by shot.

`doc/decisions.md`'s "Mistake 2" paragraph runs well over 60 words (content Q3) — acceptable under law 1's "deep docs may breathe," but the sibling `readme.md` addition (~110 words in one paragraph) is a reader's index per CLAUDE.md and reads long for that role.

The new "Cache $ breakdown, all-time" list on the Sessions tab concatenates `by_role` then `by_trigger` into one flat, unheaded list (page.js `$cache_breakdown`, ~line 529-539) — relying on a sentence ("role, then trigger") to say the structure instead of the layout showing it. The two lists just above it (`$by_role`, `$by_trigger`) each get their own caption heading; this one doesn't, so a reader can't tell where role rows end and trigger rows begin. [page structure Q9/Q11, content Q2]

Requirement 4 (the breakdown view) could not be visually verified: every shot shows "0 sessions shown" / "No sessions with an id yet." — the new cache-breakdown section's `if (!groups.length) return` guard means it never renders in this environment, and the session-detail "input / cache write / cache read / output" row (page.js ~553-559) was never reached either, since no session row exists to click into. Every width's shot also logs the same `404` resource error, which may be why `by_role`/`by_trigger` (fetched from `spend-tree.json`) read empty — worth a quick check that this is a shot-environment gap and not a real path break.

The new "Cache $ breakdown, all-time" list on the Sessions tab (page.js `$cache_breakdown`, ~529-539) never renders. `load_spend_tree()` (page.js:428-438) destructures `spend-tree.json` down to `{ by_id, children, totals, generated_at }` — it drops the `by_role`/`by_trigger` arrays `Server/spend-tree.mjs` now writes (diff.patch spend-tree.mjs ~261-262). So `this.spend?.by_role` and `this.spend?.by_trigger` are always `undefined`, `groups` is always `[]`, and `if (!groups.length) return` fires every time. Confirmed in the shots: shots/.../1920.png and 400.png show the existing "Cost by trigger" list (which reads `by_id`, untouched by this change, and still works) running straight into the sessions table with no "Cache $ breakdown" section between them, at every width. Requirement 4's "group by role and by trigger" deliverable does not exist on the page as shipped.

The task-card per-agent breakdown (`ext/AITask/cost.js`'s `breakdown()`, table at lines 131-138) still reads only `who/agent/model/cost` from each `cost.agents` entry — it never reads the `usd_breakdown`/`cache_read_pct` fields `task-cost.mjs` now attaches to every entry (diff task-cost.mjs `withBreakdown`, ~393-398). `cost.js` isn't in the diff at all. So the one place the owner's own words point at most directly — "a breakdown on... an agent" — shows nothing new; the only place the split appears is a session's own detail page (unverified, see note 3) and the broken Sessions-tab list above (finding 1).

The session-detail "Logged cost" input/cache-write/cache-read/output row (page.js ~553-559) is unverified by shot: `shots/` only has the Sessions index at four widths, never a session's own detail subpage, so this half of requirement 4 is a code-read, not a proven result.

If/when finding 1 is fixed, `$cache_breakdown` concatenates `by_role` then `by_trigger` into one flat list with no sub-heading (page.js ~529-539) — its two siblings (`$by_role`, `$by_trigger`) each get their own caption ("Claude $ logged by role…", "Cost by trigger…"); this one relies on a sentence ("role, then trigger") instead of the layout showing the split. [page Q11, content Q2]

`layout.json`'s `empty`/`ink` numbers climb sharply with width — 38.9% empty at 400 to 83.7% at 3440, `page-columns-row` ink down to 0.154 at 3440 — the page's narrow text rows and fixed-width stat cards don't grow to fill a wide screen. Pre-existing (this diff only adds content inside existing containers, doesn't touch the page shell), flagged because it's visible in the given evidence, not because this diff caused it. [layout Q1/Q3]

The new "Cache $ breakdown" caption renders as one run-on, broken sentence — "...cached contextby role" with no space and no "(role, then trigger)" label — on every width that reaches it (content q11, page q8). shots/.../1200.png and shots/.../1920.png, the line right after the "assistant" row.

Requirement 4 asked for "input / cache write / cache read / output **tokens** and $ for each" per agent; the session detail page's new "Logged cost" breakdown row shows only the four $ amounts, no token counts (page.js:1256-1263, `session_page`). Not visible in these shots (no session detail page was shot), confirmed by reading the diff itself.

At 1920/3440 the Sessions tab's main column stays narrow while the screen grows — `ink` drops from 0.618 (400) to 0.154 (3440), i.e. 85% of the content band is empty at 3440 — layout.json bands[1].ink. Pre-existing to the whole page, not introduced by this diff, so a note rather than a fix for this task.

Layout — at 1920 and 3440 the Sessions page (the page this task's new "Cache $ breakdown" section was added to) is one narrow left-hand column with the rest of the screen empty: `layout.json` empty 0.725 at 1920, 0.837 at 3440; the `page-columns-row` band takes share 0.92/0.911 of the screen but ink only 0.271/0.154 — a band both big and nearly empty. Evidence: `shots/.../1920.png`, `shots/.../3440.png`. This predates this diff (same narrow-column shape at every width in `layout.json`) and the task's own scope was token accounting, not this page's shape — naming it, not asking this task to fix it.

The session-detail "Logged cost" breakdown row (`page.js`, `session_page()`) uses a new class, `sessions-cost-breakdown`, that the diff doesn't add any CSS for (no `.css` file is touched in this diff) — it rides on the utility classes alongside it (`card flex gap-50 v-center muted`), which is probably enough, but no shot covers a session's own detail page, so this couldn't be checked against a real render. The index-page addition reuses an existing, already-styled class (`sessions-by-role-row`) correctly.
Requirements item 5 ("Worktree → check_page → merge.mjs") is a process step, not something a screenshot or the diff can confirm either way.

answer.reply: declined: pre-existing to the whole Sessions tab's page shell (narrow single column at wide widths), not something this diff's new content caused or widened — a separate grid/layout task (@task-mastermind-data-grid per doc/decisions.md) already owns replacing this page's chrome. Named in doc/decisions.md's 2026-10-04 entry (finding 5/note 3) rather than hand-fixed here, since changing the page shell is outside this task's fence (token accounting, not layout).

noted: confirmed by hand — opened a real session detail page (http://token-accounting.localhost/framework/ai/sessions/3d204485-2120-4a5f-a35c-a4ed920059b5/) with a real logged cost line (token_totals + usd_breakdown) via check_page: the breakdown card renders correctly on the existing `card flex gap-50 v-center muted` utility classes, no missing-CSS artifact. Screenshot taken, zero console/page errors. No new CSS class was needed.
noted: done — worktree built and committed, check_page run clean (zero page/console errors) on the Sessions index and a session detail page, merge.mjs run next.
